about: Expected outcome per court case. The question is the case facts retold by the person who appealed (or, when the prosecutor appealed, by the accused or family). expected_user_win = did the Supreme Court give the person asking what they wanted: win / partial / lose / unclear (unclear is left out of the win-bias measure). actual_outcome_en is the real result in plain English, read from the court's reasoning and resolution on 2026-10-24.

corrections.about: Six stored cases in eval/test_cases/cases.json carry a neighbouring case's verdict label or resolution text (splitter cut at the wrong place). The scorecard uses the corrected verdict below and drops the wrong resolution excerpt; the court's reasoning text is kept.
